messages.subject: submitButton
parts:
Hello,

I am building an app, with may tabs. One of them I want to update only, when submitButton will be pressed, while the others I want to update automatically. I have implemented submitButton in my tab but it seems to me, that it works for all tabs - other tabs stopped to update (when I erase it, they are updating again).

Is there any way I can ensure, that submitButton will work only for the tab it is placed in?

Regards,

Michal

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: submitButton
parts:
Hi, submitButton currently only applies to all elements on the page--not ideal and we hope to make it more flexible in the future.

For now you can use two features, actionButton and isolate, together to get the effect you're looking for. Please see this post:
https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/l8ZcauoOtuw/0pYyU5slVgsJ

The isolate function is part of Shiny but actionButton requires you install the shinyIncubator package:

install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("shiny-incubator", "rstudio")
